title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：radium　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 radium 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the researcher ① discovered the radium that no student in the lab would have measured, and he said the discovering was the whole of the term. The ② radium, meaning the element itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unmeasured in the book; radium, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sample of radium in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ radium at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Radium, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the researcher said the measuring is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the radium was the whole of the matter, meaning the power and not the element. The ⑥ radium, meaning the power and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; radium, he said, is either something you discover or the only word that means both element and a power. He said the power is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ radium had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ radium of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of measuring; radium, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ radium I remember is the radium measured in the paper, which closed in 1987 and is still measured as the quietest in the lab. ⑩ Radium, my mother said in 1989, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all radium, she said, is a power that has agreed to look like element. She said the power was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 镭（指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 镭（指那种镭本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：discover the radium 发现这一种镭
D. n. 镭（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 镭之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的镭之事）
F. n. 镭（指研究报告里写到、被测量的那一种）
G. n. 镭、能量（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 能量（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: discover the radium 意为“发现这一种镭”，1980 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯测量的一种镭做了一遍。
radium 意为“镭”，指那种镭本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被测量。
radium 意为“镭”，指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
radium 意为“镭”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
radium 意为“镭、能量”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种能量就是那件事的全部。
radium 意为“能量”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种镭，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
radium 意为“镭”，指研究报告里写到、被测量的那一种，到 1985 年这一种成了研究报告里的一行。
radium 意为“镭之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的镭之事是一处实验室和三个学期的测量。
radium 意为“镭”，我记得的是研究报告里测量过的那一种，1987 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一种。
radium 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，镭是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的镭。
